response.sql: WITH rating_rentals AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rentals) AS avg_rentals FROM rating_rentals) SELECT AVG(rr.rentals) AS avg_rentals_above_average, AVG(rr.rentals - o.avg_rentals) AS avg_gap_above_overall FROM rating_rentals rr CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rr.rentals > o.avg_rentals;
